objs.name: document
objs.description: A managed information object (policy, guideline, procedural instruction, work instruction, etc.) that goes through creation, editing, release, distribution, versioning and archiving in DHC VISION.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Classification of the document (e.g. policy, guideline, procedural instruction, work instruction).

attributes.name: document_level
attributes.description: Hierarchical level in the document pyramid (Level 1–4).

attributes.name: abbreviation
attributes.description: Document type abbreviation included in the document name.

attributes.name: number
attributes.description: Cross-client consecutive 4-digit number per document type.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: The title portion of the document name.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version number of the document, incremented on revision.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status in the status network (e.g. editing, released, out of force).

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which the released version is valid.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Calculated date until which the document is valid (Valid From + period of extended validity).

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Time period for validity check, default 3 years.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Period for which an invalidated document is archived before physical deletion, default 10 years.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Scope(s) associated with the document, printable via TAG technology.

attributes.name: references
attributes.description: Attribute linking the document to other documents or master data.

attributes.name: it_applications
attributes.description: Attribute linking the document to IT applications.

attributes.name: relevant_companies
attributes.description: Attribute specifying relevant companies for the document.

attributes.name: areas_of_validity
attributes.description: Attribute specifying the areas of validity for the document.

attributes.name: reader
attributes.description: User group assignment controlling read authorization.

attributes.name: author
attributes.description: Person attribute identifying the author of the document.

attributes.name: co_author
attributes.description: Person attribute for additional users with write access.

attributes.name: reviewer
attributes.description: Person attribute for users who check the document.

attributes.name: releaser
attributes.description: Person attribute for users who approve the document for release.

attributes.name: client
attributes.description: In a multi-client system, specifies in which clients the document is visible.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: A controlled sub-document (Equippment) linked to a main document, subject to its own versioning and released together with the main document.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version number of the attachment.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status, following the statuses of the main document release process.

objs.name: additional_information
objs.description: A supplementary document object attached to a main document that is not subject to the release cycle and can be published directly via property switches.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: A proposal created by an author to request changes to an existing released document, managed in the document cockpit.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Status of the change proposal (e.g. created, scheduled, completed).

objs.name: request_for_validity_extension
objs.description: A system-generated request triggered 30 days before document validity expires, processed via workflow.

objs.name: request_for_override
objs.description: A request created to invalidate a document and archive it, processed via workflow (AKS).

objs.name: request_for_reactivation
objs.description: A request to re-validate a previously invalidated document, created by the Business Admin group.

objs.name: user
objs.description: A person who interacts with documents in DHC VISION in one or more roles.

attributes.name: system_role
attributes.description: License role assigned to the user (e.g. READER, AUTHOR).

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: A group of users used for assigning authorizations and distribution to documents.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: A list of User Groups or persons maintained per document for notification or acknowledgement upon release.

attributes.name: distribution_type
attributes.description: Type of distribution: by e-mail or for acknowledgement.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: A predefined template associated with a document type, selectable when creating new document objects.

objs.name: workflow
objs.description: A system-supported process controlling steps such as creation signing, review, and release of a document.

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: A signature applied by workflow participants to complete their workflow tasks, documented per released version.

objs.name: organizational_unit
objs.description: An organizational entity to which documents can be linked via the database integration.

objs.name: risk
objs.description: A risk object to which documents can be linked via the database integration.

objs.name: dashboard
objs.description: A user and role-specific view displaying relevant documents and evaluation reports.

objs.name: report
objs.description: An evaluation or search report available to specific roles for document monitoring and status overview.

attributes.name: report_name
attributes.description: Name of the report (e.g. Status report: Documents & Instruction, Search for documents & instructions).

attributes.name: selection_parameters
attributes.description: Parameters and criteria used to filter report results.

objs.name: translation
objs.description: A language-dependent version of a released document that must be checked and released via workflow before becoming visible.

attributes.name: language
attributes.description: Target language of the translation.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: A new document object is created in DHC VISION by attaching a new information object with a selected document type and optional template.

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: The content of a document is edited using the implemented editing client in the corresponding Office component.

evts.name: edit_document_properties
evts.description: Metadata and attributes of a document are maintained or changed via the properties dialog.

evts.name: convert_document_to_pdf
evts.description: After saving, the document is automatically converted to PDF and the current version is displayed on the web.

evts.name: start_release_workflow
evts.description: The 3-step approval process (Creator – Review – Release) is initiated by the author or a co-author.

evts.name: sign_as_creator
evts.description: The registered author signs in the first workflow step of the release process.

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: Assigned reviewers check the document for technical and formal correctness and complete with electronic signature.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: Assigned releasers approve and release the document with electronic signature, making it available to readers.

evts.name: reject_document
evts.description: A reviewer or releaser rejects the document during the workflow, canceling the workflow for subsequent participants.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: After release, the document is automatically published and becomes visible to addressed readers.

evts.name: create_new_version
evts.description: A new editing version of a released document is automatically created when revisions or triggering changes occur.

evts.name: create_attachment
evts.description: A new controlled attachment (Equippment) is created and linked to a main document, triggering a new version of the main document.

evts.name: modify_attachment
evts.description: An existing attachment is modified, triggering a new version of the associated main document.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: An attachment is marked for archiving and archived with the release of the next main document version.

evts.name: create_additional_information
evts.description: An additional information object is added to a document without affecting the main document version or release cycle.

evts.name: delete_additional_information
evts.description: An additional information object is deleted directly from the document due to lack of criticality.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: An author creates a change proposal for an existing released document without affecting the document content or version.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: A change proposal is planned for implementation, creating a new version of the document.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: The author documents the editing of a change proposal; the creator is notified and the proposal is no longer displayed.

evts.name: create_request_for_validity_extension
evts.description: The system automatically creates a validity extension request 30 days before the document validity expires.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: The releaser (and optionally author/reviewer) confirms that the document remains valid, updating the Valid Until date.

evts.name: create_request_for_override
evts.description: A user with write access creates a request to invalidate (override) a document.

evts.name: override_document
evts.description: The document and its attachments are declared out of force, authorizations are revoked except for the archive group.

evts.name: create_request_for_reactivation
evts.description: The Business Admin group creates a request to reactivate an invalidated document.

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: An invalidated document is restored to a new version with original metadata, authorizations, distribution list and attachments.

evts.name: distribute_by_email
evts.description: Users and user groups on the distribution list are informed by e-mail notification upon release of a new document version.

evts.name: distribute_for_acknowledgement
evts.description: Users and user groups are requested to actively confirm acknowledgement of a released document via workflow.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: A recipient confirms acknowledgement of a document, which is documented and summarized for the author team.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Released document content is translated into another language and submitted for review and release.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: The translated language version is checked, reviewed and released, making it visible to readers in the corresponding language.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Read or change authorizations are assigned to user groups or persons for a specific document.

evts.name: send_email_notification
evts.description: The system informs involved users about workflow status, tasks, validity extensions, overrides or other events via e-mail.

evts.name: physical_deletion
evts.description: After the archive period has expired, archived documents are physically deleted from the system.

o2o.description: An Attachment belongs to and is released with a main Document.
Additional Information is supplementary content attached to a Document.
A Change Proposal belongs to and is displayed in a specific Document.
A Request For Validity Extension is linked to the Document whose validity is being checked.
A Request For Override is created for a specific Document to be invalidated.
A Request For Reactivation references the invalidated Document to be reactivated.
One or more Document Templates can be defined per document type and selected when creating a Document.
A Distribution List is maintained per Document for notification or acknowledgement distribution.
User Groups are assigned to the Distribution List for a Document.
Users are assigned to User Groups which control their authorizations and distribution.
Documents can reference other Documents via the References attribute.
Documents can be linked to Organizational Units via the database integration.
Documents can be linked to Risks via the database integration.
A Translation is a language-dependent version of a released Document.
Electronic Signatures are documented per released version of a Document.
